input.title: Fix Chat Customizations layout and context
input.body:
## Summary

- preserve the originating chat session when opening Chat Customizations from a chat title action
- align Tools, marketplace, and migration content and keep migration controls clear of the scrollbar
- improve MCP running-status contrast in light themes

## Testing

- `npm run typecheck-client`
- `npm run valid-layers-check`
- focused `aiCustomizationManagement` unit test
- Component Explorer Tools, MCP server, prompt migration, and user-data migration fixtures
